result.title: A Hardware-Aware Comprehensive Study of Edge Vision Deployment with A Unified Hardware-Model-Runtime Mapping Framework
result.summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has driven the deployment of computer vision directly on resource-constrained edge devices. However, the extreme heterogeneity of edge hardware architectures poses major challenges in selecting and designing suitable vision models. This survey bridges the gap between edge hardware constraints, model architectures, and deployment software toolchains. We establish a comprehensive taxonomy classifying edge hardware into three distinct tiers: mid-range devices (GPUs and dedicated NPUs or TPUs), dedicated embedded MPU or SoC processors, and microcontrollers (MCUs). We aggregate and analyze multi-source benchmark results for image classification and object detection across the computing spectrum, spanning from tens of watts down to milliwatt-scale bare-metal MCUs. Based on these empirical findings, we propose a two-tiered hardware-to-model mapping framework that provides concrete model selection matrices across performance priorities (Speed, Balanced, Accuracy) and actionable architectural design principles (peak SRAM budgeting, resolution-first scaling, and algorithm-compiler co-design). Finally, we highlight critical deployment challenges including toolchain fragmentation, operator incompatibility, and Vision Transformer feasibility, and outline promising future research directions in on-device adaptation and sustainable Edge AI.

AI.brief_summary: 这篇综述按 GPU/NPU、嵌入式 SoC、MCU 三个层级梳理边缘视觉硬件，汇总分类与检测任务的多源基准结果，并提出硬件到模型的映射框架与选型矩阵。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中关于峰值 SRAM 预算、分辨率优先缩放与算法—编译器协同设计的分层成本讨论，可能为 LVR 迭代式 latent 推理的显存与延迟开销、停止决策的成本建模提供参考，但需核查其结论能否迁移到动态多步推理。
